title: The cohomological dimension of a directed limit of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes is bounded by the dimensions of the approximants
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma bounds the cohomological dimension of a directed limit of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes by the maximum of the dimensions of the approximants (statement lines 19632-19637). The proof (proof lines 19639-19648) expresses a torsion sheaf on the limit as the limit of the pullbacks of its pushforwards and applies the colimit theorem to compute the cohomology as a colimit, giving the bound. H2: two standard inputs, written out.
